# Keep shared toggle animation inside the reduced-motion preference branch

The shared toggle stylesheet declares its track and thumb transitions only when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference. The assigned change removes the separate header-specific icon transition. Preserve the shared motion owner and reduced-motion gate for nearby toggle changes; a duplicate component transition can create a different motion contract. No animated UI or preference-state test ran here. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Toggle motion ownership.
